title: Self-Hosted Agents: a sensor verified, not vouched
lede: The Kubernetes sensor is enrolled as its own principal. Each report carries a short-lived token minted for a generated audience; the controller verifies it and takes the node from the token, then applies the policy bound to the identity. The lab runs no eBPF: the reports are simulated. Ping release claim, UNVERIFIED on our tenant. Simulated.

nodes.label: Findings attributed to the node in the token
Decision: allow, monitor, warn or deny

edges.label: report with its token; the body's node is ignored
node taken from the token's claims
audit: would have blocked; enforce: blocked

steps.title: Enrol
steps.what: Privilege generates an audience nobody can guess and creates the sensor's own identity.

steps.title: Project
steps.what: The platform projects a short-lived token for that audience into the pod. No standing secret is stored on the node.

steps.title: Report
steps.what: The sensor reports with its token. A node named in the body is ignored.

steps.title: Key set
steps.what: The controller verifies issuer, subject, audience and scope against the issuer's key set.

steps.title: Attribute
steps.what: The reporting node is taken from the token's claims, so a compromised agent cannot misattribute findings.

steps.title: Policy
steps.what: The policy bound to the identity decides, for the namespaces in scope.

steps.title: Decide
steps.what: In audit mode a denied finding is recorded as would-have-blocked; in enforce mode it is blocked.
